name: manual_d341f3
claim: Test an instruction's premise before executing it: if its literal reading removes a protection (no hard dependency dropping replay protection), or presumes state that has changed (amend a commit already on the remote), record the narrower safe reading or ask, instead of complying literally or rewriting remote history.

decisions.notes: 2026-10-19: the operator confirmed the scoped reading of decision 3, and for the amend request a plain new commit and a fast-forward push avoided rewriting history.
